extreme 10x GOALS, and

money and effort necessary to bring their projects to the point of success.

The athletes set out to become number one - nothing else.

By the way, check out my other video about black swans and how one best deals with randomness (link in the description).

people problems ...

Bottom line - the more actions you take, the better your chances of getting "lucky".
